name: outfithub
description: OutfitHub – Medusa v2 commerce backend + Next.js storefront

scripts.install:all: npm --prefix apps/backend install && npm --prefix apps/storefront install
scripts.setup:db: npm --prefix apps/backend run migrate && npm --prefix apps/backend run seed
scripts.typecheck: npm --prefix apps/backend run typecheck && npm --prefix apps/storefront run typecheck
scripts.test: npm --prefix apps/backend run test:unit && npm --prefix apps/storefront run test
scripts.build: npm --prefix apps/backend run build && npm --prefix apps/storefront run build
